method: Visual inspection of supplied native contact sheet, 12 additional regular samples at 2 fps, face crops at 2 fps, and accepted wide identity reference. ffprobe confirms 1920x1080, 24 fps, 145 video frames, 6.05-second container. Restored source frames 10 through 136 were inspected using 3 fps face samples, plus every frame from 128 through 136. Restored container is 6.042 seconds with 145 frames at 24 fps.

findings.identity: Visually consistent with reference in face, clear glasses, hair, navy shirt, study, table and light direction.
findings.framing: Static wide composition retains both complete hands and forearms. No apparent generated camera move across inspected samples.
findings.head_and_hands: Restrained lean and slight lateral head changes, with quiet resting hands. No obvious exaggerated gesture or repeating pose cycle in sampled frames.
findings.expression: Mild inner-brow lift/furrow and near-lens attention read as an earnest, considering question. Expression is more engaged than neutral reference without broad caricature.
findings.mouth: Mouth alternates rounded, open and narrower shapes; inspected frames do not show a persistent clenched-teeth pose, duplicated teeth, or obvious face warping. Native mouth remains active near the end, so a closed-mouth resting tail is not yet established.
findings.restored_mouth: Selected restored samples retain clear open and rounded shapes without gross duplicated teeth, jaw warping, or face discontinuity. Frames 128 through 136 show the mouth narrowing and settling; final three inspected frames are nearly unchanged, with lips slightly parted.
findings.restored_tail: Near source 5.46 to 5.71 seconds, the mouth settles but does not become fully closed. The planned heading cut is reasonable; a fully closed-mouth resting hold must not be claimed.

material_issues.item: Rest ends with slightly parted lips
material_issues.reason: Actual selected ending settles but does not fulfill a literal closed-mouth hold. This alone does not justify another provider generation.

lip_sync_verdict: Perceptual lip sync is not certified. Root reported strong three-window technical audio alignment; this still-frame review only assesses visible mouth shapes and continuity.
limits: Sparse selected-range sampling cannot exclude short transient artifacts or quantify repetition across the whole episode.
Tail frames 128 through 136 were inspected consecutively, but natural-motion quality at playback speed remains an owner-review judgment.
No owner acceptance or picture lock is implied.

restored_selection.alignment_source: Root measured three speech windows; not independently remeasured in this visual review.

recommendation: Keep the planned selected range and heading cut for owner review. No material picture defect requiring a retry was found in inspected frames.
